sql: WITH modes(mode) AS (SELECT 'all_types' UNION ALL SELECT 'dw_only'), nets AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount WHEN txn_type='withdrawal' OR mode='all_types' THEN -txn_amount ELSE 0 END) net FROM customer_transactions CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode='all_types' OR txn_type IN('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), balances AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) closing FROM nets), prev AS (SELECT *,LAG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) previous_closing,LAG(m) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) previous_m FROM balances) SELECT mode,m,COUNT(*) current_active_customers,SUM(MAX(COALESCE(previous_closing,0),0)) clipped_previous_observed,SUM(CASE WHEN previous_m=date(m,'-1 month') THEN MAX(previous_closing,0) ELSE 0 END) clipped_previous_calendar_active,SUM(previous_m<>date(m,'-1 month')) gap_customers FROM prev WHERE m>'2020-01-01' GROUP BY mode,m ORDER BY mode,m
